units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>יהיב פ׳ בין וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite>) he divided a chicken between his host and his wife.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:2:4">Y. Ber. VI, 10ᶜ</cite> top <he>ובירך על פ׳ וכ׳</he> and said the blessing over the chicken, saying &c.; a. e.—Pl. <he>פְּרִיגִין</he>, <cite ref="Q01559"><he>פַּרְגִּיוָן</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q01559"><he>פַּרְגְּיָין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17:3">Gen. R. s. 17</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:14">Lev. R. s. 34</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 665:10">Yalk. ib. 665</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 352">Yalk. Is. 352</cite>. Lam. R. l. c.; a. e.
